**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

Our rights under this agreement come by way of ownership and assignment rather than a revocable licence-in:

- **11.1.1.1** — PB retains all Existing PB Intellectual Property and independently arising PB IP.
- **11.1.1.3(a)–(b)** — PB is the sole and exclusive owner of all Trial Inventions regardless of inventorship; SFJ assigns and must cause its Affiliates, employees, consultants and Permitted Third Parties to assign.
- **11.1.1.3(b)–(c)** — where assignment is unavailable, the fallback to us is a *worldwide, royalty-free, fully-paid, freely-assignable licence with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers* — i.e. irrevocable in substance, transferable to successors, and extendable to our Affiliates and contractors through sublicensing. This meets or exceeds the preferred position.
- **11.1.1.4** — PB acquires sole and exclusive ownership of the Trial Data Package and Research Results.
- **11.1.1.6** — the only grant running the other way is protective of us: SFJ obtains no rights in PB IP beyond what is necessary to perform.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: the contractor licences are procured on a commercially reasonable efforts basis with an express carve-out for contractor background/improvement technology (11.1.1.3(c)), and the AZ License prevails over conflicting terms. The Program Transfer grant to SFJ lives in the Exhibit O form, outside this text, and would be reviewed separately.
